info.title: LiveKit Universal API
info.description: LiveKit is an open source platform for realtime audio, video, telephony, and AI agent communications.

post.description: Creates a new ingress in LiveKit.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

inputType.description: Ingress input type, such as RTMP_INPUT, WHIP_INPUT, or URL_INPUT.

enableTranscoding.description: For RTMP_INPUT, LiveKit requires transcoding to be enabled. Set false only for input types/configurations that support bypassing transcoding.

url.description: HTTP, HLS, MP4, MOV, MKV, OGG, MP3, M4A, or SRT URL for URL_INPUT ingress.

participant_identity.description: Participant identity used by the ingress.

reusable.description: Whether the ingress can be reused.

emptyTimeout.description: Seconds to keep the room open if no one joins.

departureTimeout.description: Seconds the room remains open after the last participant leaves.

maxParticipants.description: Maximum participant count; 0 means no limit.

departure_timeout.description: Seconds before participant departure is finalized.

empty_timeout.description: Seconds before an empty room is closed.
